verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated sandbox or test environment. Two features give indirect support. Cloud agents run on Warp's cloud infrastructure or your own, separate from the local machine. Agent profiles and admin-controlled autonomy can restrict file access, command execution, MCP usage and where the agent can act, which could keep agents away from production resources. Missing for 10: an explicit sandboxed or ephemeral execution environment, documented isolation from production data or credentials, test/sandbox mode documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
